rules: The first response descriptor is serialized and verified before the accepting native batch append. Never emit a receipt event to retain it.
A root binding replay loads that exact descriptor before resolving any mutable dependency. Async exact retry always repeats its original 202 acknowledgment; progress belongs to status GET.
Use a static allowlist registry of result schema to concrete generated serializer; never instantiate a runtime type from a supplied string.
Protected capability response content is encrypted and only referenced by native facts; no ticket/bearer material in events, intents, queues, traces or unprotected immutable content.
